web.title: What can Investment Promotion Agencies do for you?
web.description:
### **IPAs can help to alleviate many of the pain points in the investment process – if a company knows what to do with them. FDI consultant Douglas van den Berghe offers guidance on getting the most out of the relationship.**
These member-driven network organisations provide knowledge, support and training and have annual events where IPAs share best practices and further enhance their expertise and capabilities.

### **Guidance to follow when using an IPA for an FDI project**
Keep the FDI project highly confidential and make sure a non-disclosure agreement is signed.
